name: Dack Fayden
description: A human mage from Drakeston on Fiora who became a planeswalker and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.

description_citations.text: "Dack Fayden". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sifa Grent wipes out Drakeston with the Ancient Fang while Dack is away.
timeline.quote: until it was wiped out by Sifa Grent using the Ancient Fang

citation.text: "Fiora", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack goes to Innistrad and makes enemies of the Falkenrath vampires.
timeline.quote: He wasted no time in blundering directly into the vampires of the world, gaining the enmity of the Falkenrath in the process.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack and Ingrid confront Sifa as she gathers a town; Dack drives her off but loses her.
timeline.quote: Dack drove Sifa and her minions away, but he lost her before he could exact his revenge.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov freezes the Cathars in stasis and trades knowledge of Sifa for the dagger and their lives.
timeline.quote: He traded knowledge of Sifa for the dagger and the lives of the Cathars.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malfegor captures Dack on Grixis hoping to steal his spark, but Dack escapes.
timeline.quote: Before Malfegor could attempt his plan, though, Dack escaped

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: IDW's comic series, tied to the Innistrad storyline, introduces the planeswalker Dack Fayden.
timeline.quote: It introduced a new planeswalker, Dack Fayden , who was involved in the Innistrad storyline.

citation.text: "Dengeki-Maoh", section "IDW comics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin trades Dack Fayden his life for the Ancient Fang and points him to Grixis.
timeline.quote: In exchange for the Ancient Fang , Sorin let Dack and his friends live.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "The Ancient Fang". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack deduces Sifa plans to drain Vitu-Ghazi and fights her in the City Tree; one of his colleagues stabs her and Dack kills her with his most powerful spell.
timeline.quote: bringing vengeance upon the death mage at last

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Return to Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack takes a magical gauntlet from the Boros Legion's Sunhome, travels to Theros, finds the other half and defeats a kraken.
timeline.quote: Fayden slipped on the completed gauntlet, felt an ancient power within him, and defeated the sea creature.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack learns he will be affected by the Sleep Curse and enters Theros's Underworld.
timeline.quote: was last seen entering a portal to Theros's Underworld

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden enters a gorgon's lair searching for an artifact.
timeline.quote: Another gorgon was encountered by Dack Fayden when he entered her lair searching for a magical artifact.

citation.text: "Gorgon", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok plans a Sleep curse over all Theros but Dack, Ravos and the dead put an end to it.
timeline.quote: Dack, Ravos , and the dead put an end to Ashiok's Sleep curse.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "A grander scheme". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack and Marsh pick a fight with ruffians; Marsh is killed by a sword and Dack is struck down, and his spark flares.
timeline.quote: Lying smoldering next to the body of his friend, Dack’s spark flared and he ascended.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack is beaten by a guardian Djinn on Alkabah while stealing an artifact and imprisoned, where his hand is stained red.
timeline.quote: The guardian Djinn beat him horribly and left him for the city guards.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack returns to Drakeston to find the town massacred, including Mariel.
timeline.quote: the entire town having been murdered while he was away

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack steals a dagger from the Cult of Rakdos and learns it was held by Sifa Grent, who murdered Drakeston.
timeline.quote: he learned who was responsible for the deaths of everyone he had known. Her name was Sifa Grent .

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge; Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden defeat him, and Hazoret gives them her spear.
timeline.quote: Hazoret gave them her spear, reassuring Samut about the condition of Amonkhet's population

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack is lured back to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped by the Immortal Sun, then fights the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack touches Kiora's bident to copy its powers, but the attempt fails.
timeline.quote: He also managed to touch Kiora 's bident without her noticing

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack distracts Tezzeret so Karn can destroy the Bridge control mechanism, collapsing the portal.
timeline.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazoret convinces Dack to return to the battle on Ravnica, and he declines a second chance to escape.
timeline.quote: He was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Eternals, Dack has his spark harvested and dies, thinking of Mariel.
timeline.quote: one of them managed to grab him by surprise and harvest his spark , killing him

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers visit Hazoret's camp; she tells Dack Fayden to face his destiny and lends her spear against Bolas, which Karn transports to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Hazoret lent her spear as a weapon to take down Bolas

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn flies an explosive micro-drone into Tezzeret's chest, collapsing the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

citation.text: "Karn", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden touches Kiora's bident to copy it, and she catches him.
timeline.quote: She caught him, and the attempt made him look like he regretted his decision.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nixilis joins Karn, Dack and Samut to go through the Planar Bridge to Amonkhet; Karn destroys the Bridge mechanism in Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden, Ob Nixilis, Karn and Samut travel to Amonkhet and shut off the portal.
timeline.quote: traveled to Amonkhet and shut it off

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, Nixilis, Dack and Samut go through Bolas's Planar Bridge to Amonkhet to shut it from the other side.
timeline.quote: Karn , Ob Nixilis , Dack Fayden , and Samut volunteered to go through Bolas' Planar Bridge to Amonkhet and shut the portal down from the other side.

citation.text: "Samut", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, Ob Nixilis, Dack and Samut defeat Tezzeret on Amonkhet, closing the portal, and meet Hazoret, who gives them her spear.
timeline.quote: On Amonkhet, they defeat Tezzeret , causing the portal to close.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the final assault on Bolas' Citadel, Dack is killed by Eternals who harvest his spark.
timeline.quote: During the battle, Dack is killed by Eternals, who harvest his spark.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Attendees argue about surrender or hiding, and Vorel blames planeswalkers while the archer and Samut insist Bolas is never sated.
timeline.quote: There is literally nothing left of my world, Skalla, thanks to him.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden overhears and backs the plan, and Chandra sets off with Rai, Nissa and guildmembers.
timeline.quote: They set off for New Prahv.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: An Eternal harvests Dack Fayden's Spark once the Sun is reactivated, killing him.
timeline.quote: As Dack's Spark was ripped from him

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Dack and Marsh, adept young mages lacking judgment, pick a fight with brutes one night and Marsh is killed.
timeline.quote: One night, their genius got the best of them and they picked a fight with brutes, resulting in the death of Marsh.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dack's spark ignites at Marsh's death and he becomes a planeswalker and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: In that moment, Dack’s spark ignited and he became a Planeswalker—and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
